information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

HAMMER FOR KUNTSCHER NAIL EXTRACTOR 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1992" 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensional and other requirements for hammer for Kuntscher nail extractor used 
in orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Material — Stainless steel of Designation 20O13 of IS : 6603-1972 'Specification for stainless 
steel bars and flats'. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

4. Heat Treatment — Shall be hardened and tempered to 400 to 450 HV.

IS : 7108 -1973 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The hammer shall be formed in one piece. 

5.2 The surfaces of the recess shall be perfect. 

5.3 It shall be free from draw-marks, pits, cracks and other surface defects. 

5.4 It shall be passivated and polished bright. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — Scrub the instrument with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water 
and then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the instrument, immerse in copper sulphate solution at 
room temperature for 6 minutes and wash with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 

The copper sulphate solution shall be made up as follows: 

Copper sulphate (CuS0 4 .5H 2 0) 4-0 g 

Sulphuric acid (H 2 S0 4 ) (sp gr 1 -84) 1 0*0 g 
Distilled water [see IS : 1070-1960 Specification for water, distilled 

quality (revised)] 900 ml 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the instrument, but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Shall be marked with the manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 iSi Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1 1 0001 . 

8. Packing — The hammer shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
